title: Saab Reveals MCMV 24 Mine Warfare Concept Tailored for the Baltic
summary: Saab has unveiled its MCMV 24 concept, a new mine warfare vessel designed specifically for operations in the Baltic Sea. The concept incorporates Glass Reinforced Plastic (GRP) composite construction, high-speed patrol features, and integrated autonomous mine countermeasures systems.

title: North Korea Commissions Second Choe Hyon-Class Guided-Missile Destroyer
summary: North Korea has commissioned its second Choe Hyon-class guided-missile destroyer, named Kang Kon (52). This vessel features 88 VLS cells and advanced phased-array radars, indicating a continued expansion of the Korean People's Navy's capabilities.

title: Indian Navy Eyes 1,000 km Ship-Based Loitering Munitions
summary: The Indian Navy has issued a Request for Information (RFI) for ship-based loitering munitions with a range of 1,000 km. This initiative seeks to enhance the navy's long-range strike capabilities and explore local contenders for such advanced systems.

title: Sweden signs HIMARS deal, forges rocket artillery pact with Finland
summary: Sweden has signed a $732 million deal to acquire "just over" ten HIMARS launchers and a substantial quantity of ammunition. This acquisition is part of a broader rocket artillery pact with Finland, strengthening regional defense capabilities.

title: Croatia buys South Korean rocket artillery after HIMARS purchase from the US
summary: Croatia has purchased South Korean rocket artillery systems, following an earlier acquisition of HIMARS from the U.S. This diversification comes as the U.S. government has indicated possible delays in deliveries of military equipment, including HIMARS ammunition, potentially due to the Iran war.

title: Solid-state cooler uses heat to make things cold
summary: Scientists have developed a novel solid-state cooling device that can generate cold temperatures using heat. This breakthrough could enable electronic components, such as processors, to recycle their own waste heat for cooling purposes, offering significant energy efficiency potential.

title: Serious human illness transmitted by ticks has been identified
summary: Scientists have identified a new pathogen transmitted from ticks to humans, capable of causing serious illness. This discovery highlights the ongoing threat of zoonotic diseases to human health and underscores the importance of continued research in this area.

title: Our sex organs could be pacemakers for aging through our body
summary: New research suggests that sex organs may act as "pacemakers" for the aging process throughout the body. This discovery could offer novel insights into the mechanisms of aging, inflammation, and genetics, potentially leading to new research avenues and interventions.

title: Teaching a hexapedal robot to walk like a stick insect
summary: Researchers have successfully taught a six-legged robot to mimic the walking gait of a stick insect. This biomimicry research aims to improve robot locomotion for navigating challenging terrains, such as disaster zones or extraterrestrial landscapes, where wheeled vehicles cannot reach.

title: Wild origami camper cube seizes command of your van to make it livable
summary: The Italian brand Cubivan has introduced an innovative modular camper system that slides out from a van and expands to create a sheltered living space. This "origami" design includes a kitchen, wet bathroom, and a hard-sided rooftop pod, transforming a standard van into a fully livable camper.

summary: The attacker built 293 separate vaults for the stolen Bitcoin and is emptying them in order of size, largest first.

title: Joe Biden’s son to launch memecoin, will send to TRUMP holders: WSJ
summary: Hunter Biden will reportedly distribute 200 million of the LAPTOP token to his substack subscribers, members of a mailing list and investors in President Donald Trump’s memecoin.

title: Capital B adds 376 Bitcoin in $29M purchase, boosting holdings to 3,521 BTC
summary: Capital B’s latest Bitcoin purchase was its largest in nearly a year, pushing the French company ahead of H100 Group among publicly traded BTC holders.

title: Citi, DBS complete first weekend tokenized cross-border deposit on Swift
summary: Citi and DBS completed their first tokenized cross-border transfer over the weekend, using Swift’s blockchain-based ledger to circumvent the constraints of traditional banking hours.
